simple.meaning: חָמָס (châmâç) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “violence ; by implication, wrong ; by metonymy unjust gain.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 60 times across Genesis, Exodus, Deuteronomy, Judges, 2 Samuel, and 15 more, beginning at Genesis 6:11. Its contexts include family, righteousness.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חָמָס (H2555).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: חָמָס (châmâç) / H2555 is traced through Genesis 6:11, Genesis 6:13, Genesis 16:5, Genesis 49:5 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.short: violence ; by implication, wrong ; by metonymy unjust gain
definitions.usage: cruel(-ty), damage, false, injustice, × oppressor, unrighteous, violence (against, done), violent (dealing), wrong.
definitions.full: H2555. chamas חָמָס noun masculine Psa 7:17 violence, wrong — absolute ׳ח Gen 6:11 + 44 t.; construct חֲמַס Judg 9:24 7 t.; suffix חֲמָסִי Gen 16:5 ; Jer 51:35 (in both = wrong done to me ); חֲמָסוֺ Psa 7:17 ; plural חֲמָסִים 2Sam 22:49 3 t.; — violence , specifically of physical violence Judg 9:24 ; 2Sam 22:3 (not || Psa 18:3 ), Obadiah 10; Hab 1:9 ; Jer 51:35 (of Chaldeans), Hab 2:8 , 17 (twice in verse); Joel 4:19; Psa 72:14 ; but also wrong , including injurious language, harsh treatment, etc. Gen 16:5 (J, of wrong done to Sarah by, Hagar), Job 19:7 ; Mal 2:16 ; in General of rude wickedness of men, their noisy, wild, ruthlessness Micah 6:12 ; Hab 1:2 ; Zeph 1:9 ; Prov 10:6 , 11 ; 13:2 ; 26:6 + Ezek 7:11 (si vera lectio, see Co), || שֹׁד Amos 3:10 ; Hab 1:3 ; Jer 6:7 ; 20:8 ; Ezek 45:9 ; Isa 60:18 , || רִיב Psa 55:10 , || עָמָל 7:17 , || גַּאֲוָה 73:6 , ח ׳אֹהֵב 11:5 (|| רָשָׁע ), denied, of servant of ׳י Isa 53:9 , ׳ח בארץ Jer 51:46 , compare Gen 6:11 , 13 (P), Ezek 8:17 ; 12:19 ; ח נְאוֺת ׳מַחֲשַׁכֵּיאֶֿרֶץ מָֽלְאוּ Psa 74:20 , ח מָֽלְאָה ׳הָעִיר Ezek 7:23 ; 28:16 , ח ׳שֶׁבֶת Amos 6:3 is (probably) enthronement of violence ; ח ׳כְּלֵי Gen 49:5 (poem) instrument, weapons, of violence ; — other phrases are: ׳ח בְּיָדַיִם Jonah 3:8 ; 1Chr 12:17 , compare Job 16:17 , ׳ח יְדֵיכֶם Psa 58:3 and ח ׳מֹּעַל בְּכַמֵּיהֶם Isa 59:6 ; ח ׳עֵד i.e. a witness that promotes violence and wrong Exod 23:1 (JE), Deut 19:16 , ח ׳עֵדֵי Psa 35:11 ; חָמָס וִיפֵהַ שֶׁקֶר עֵדֵי 27:12 ; ח ׳שׂנאת 25:19 +? violence; חָמָס אִישׁ = violent man 18:49 ( 2Sam 22:49 has the later ׳א חמסים , compare below) Psa 140:12 ; Prov 3:31 ; 16:29 ; חמסים אישׁ (later) Psa 140:2 ; 140:5 ; 2Sam 22:49 ; חֲמָסִים יֵין Prov 4:17 i.e. wine gained by violence (|| רֶשַׁע לֶחֶם ).
